purpose: External falsification/archive inputs only; source commentary is not ground truth and must not be used for metric tuning.

interpretation_contract.label_text: Preserved source-catalog paraphrases, not independently transcribed verbatim quotations.
interpretation_contract.label_strength: Explicit means the source makes the statement, not that the statement is objectively true. Inferred category/reviewer/source-type assignments carry their own strength.
interpretation_contract.unknowns: Null or unknown means not established by the catalog/archive; never fill from a generic retailer URL.
interpretation_contract.relations: Source ordering and paired views only; no numerical goodness axis or cross-group equivalence.
interpretation_contract.media_paths: Relative to the root of storage_bundle ZIP; sequence frame paths are relative to their referenced source manifest directory.
interpretation_contract.applicability: Archived motion is a candidate input, not proof of the normal Sparkles 360 contract. Stills/previews are not complete rotations. Simulation and real-stone acquisition domains remain distinct.

general_principles.label: The most important information in 360 video is the dance once the diamond moves.
Avoid very large areas going dark together or areas remaining dark through substantial movement.
Grey in vendor video is ambiguous: leakage, lower-angle/dimmer source return, or inefficient light return.
